name: App definition ID
description: ID of this app definition (same as in the app URL / API). Used with the App Action call API. Optional if you use Vite env VITE_CONTENTFUL_APP_DEFINITION_ID for local dev only.

name: Count inbound links — App Action ID
description: Optional. App Action ID for getIncomingLinksCount. If unset, the sidebar queries CMA directly for the total.

name: Remove links — App Action ID
description: ID of the batched App Action: remove inbound links (targetEntryId, batchSize, skip, dryRun, publishStrategy, …).

name: Republish after unlink
description: When enabled, entries that were already published are published again after inbound links are removed. When disabled (default), changes are saved as drafts only.

name: Default unlink batch size
description: Default number of linking entries to process per Remove links run in the sidebar (1–100). Falls back to 20 if unset.
